text:
Alex Moreno: Quick idea — run a short SI "embedded accelerator" program that combines a hardware sandbox (partner GPUs + reference rack) with a lightweight accreditation exam. Goal: faster field readiness and a marketplace badge. Thoughts?
Maya Patel: Love this. Two immediate asks: 1) a reproducible lab image + infra as code, 2) a scoring rubric we can hand to partners.
Samir Khan: +1. We should use a gated private marketplace listing for certified SIs. Partner HW/vendors get a 'verified with Redwood' tag.
Jin Park: Sequence proposal: (a) build a 3-step lab (deploy, optimize for latency/cost, troubleshoot a failing rollout), (b) 1-day instructor-led workshop, (c) 1-hour timed accreditation test.
Tess Rogers: Agree. Operational notes: need temporary vpc peering, KMS access patterns, and a short data exfil checklist for security sign-off. I'll draft the compliance checklist.
Alex Moreno: I'll own lab scenarios. Samir, can you coordinate with the marketplace team for the badge metadata + pricing guidance?
Samir Khan: Yep — I'll loop in @marketplace. Also thinking about HW partners: can we offer a sandbox discount code so SIs can spin GPUs for the lab?
Maya Patel: Good idea — finance will need a SKU. @tess can you capture required limits for discounted SKUs?
Tess Rogers: On it. Also we should include a hardware failure simulation step (network partition, OOM on quantized model) so SI engineers prove recovery steps.
onboard-bot: lab-provisioner: test cluster for "si-embedded-1959" created in staging, alloc 4xA100-40GB, hours=72
Jin Park: Nice. For the accreditation rubric: pass if >=85% on scenario tasks + 2 live debugging exercises. We should publish a rubric doc and a sample scoring sheet.
Alex Moreno: Draft timeline: week 0 — infra & doc; week 1 — first internal dry run; week 2 — pilot with 3 SIs; week 3 — iterate on scoring, week 4 — public call for cohort 1. Any blockers?
Maya Patel: Resource ask: need 2 instructor SMEs + one solutions engineer to run pilot sessions. Marketing will need a one-pager for the marketplace page.
Samir Khan: I'll assign marketplace contact; @Jin can you confirm instructor availability?
Jin Park: I can run two pilot sessions. Would prefer sessions in APAC-friendly hours for partner timezone coverage.
Tess Rogers: Security quick note: for accreditation, don't allow partner code to access customer keys. Recommend ephemeral test keys and constrained IAM roles.
Alex Moreno: Approved. I'll put together the lab guide + git repo with IaC and sample prompts. Expect a PR by EOD Friday.
Maya Patel: I'll build the scorecard template and a slide deck for the enablement workshop.
Samir Khan: After pilot, let's measure: mean time to onboard (days), pass rate %, and marketplace conversion rate.
Alex Moreno: Perfect. Thanks all — next sync Friday 11am PT. Please drop blocking issues in this thread. :thumbsup:
